card.name: Gap before a dose number
card.fires_on: Mostly the space or small word (a, to) just before a dose amount such as 6 mg or 12 mg, usually after an extended-release drug name. One context is an XML-style configuration description, where it fires on the word a.

modes.label: Before dose amount
modes.description: A blank space or the word to sits right before a number and mg, after a drug product name or in a dose range.
modes.example: the recommended initial dose of paliperidone extended-release tablets is<< >>3 mg once daily

modes.description: The word a at the start of a description of a cache scheme in configuration documentation with XML tags.
